input.overview: Repeated drop-target-bank completions open the main Mac's Galaxy awards. The first lights upper-lane Extra Ball, center-target Bonus X, and 50,000 at the upper-left target; the second adds center-target Extra Ball, and the third adds left-outlane Special. The captive ball advances Hole Bonus and lights 50,000 at the center target, while completing M-A-C lights the right-outlane Special.
input.simpleOverview: In Mac's Galaxy, complete the drop-target bank once for upper-lane Extra Ball, center-target Bonus X, and 50,000 at the upper-left target. The second completion adds center-target Extra Ball; the third adds left-outlane Special. Hit the captive ball to advance Hole Bonus, and complete M-A-C to light Special at the right outlane.
input.summary: Repeat the drop-target bank because each completion adds another useful collect. Use captive-ball hits to build Hole Bonus, then collect it at the right hole or preserve it for the end of the game. Take M-A-C lanes whenever the ball reaches the top.

quickInfo.name: First bank completion
quickInfo.summary: Light upper-lane Extra Ball, center-target Bonus X, and 50,000 at the upper-left target.

quickInfo.name: Second bank completion
quickInfo.summary: Keep the first awards and add Extra Ball at the center target.

quickInfo.name: Third bank completion
quickInfo.summary: Keep the earlier awards and add Special at the left outlane.

quickInfo.name: Hole Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Hit the captive ball to advance it; collect at the right hole or at game end.

quickInfo.name: M-A-C Special
quickInfo.summary: Complete the top M-A-C lanes to light the right outlane.

steps.text: Complete the drop-target bank once to light upper-lane Extra Ball, center-target Bonus X, and 50,000 at the upper-left target.
Complete the bank a second time to add Extra Ball at the center target, then a third time to add Special at the left outlane.
Hit the captive ball to advance Hole Bonus and light 50,000 at the center target.
When Hole Bonus reaches 5, hit the captive ball for 20,000; collect Hole Bonus at the right hole or let it score at the end of the game.
Complete M-A-C in the top lanes to light Special at the right outlane.

alternatives.title: Hole Bonus route
alternatives.when: Use this when the captive ball is safer than a full target-bank cycle.

steps.text: Repeat the captive ball to advance Hole Bonus.
At Hole Bonus 5, hit the captive ball for 20,000.
Shoot the right hole to collect Hole Bonus, or preserve the progress for the end of the game.

buildsToward.title: Bonus X, both Extra Balls, and both Specials

steps.text: Complete the drop-target bank three times to open its full award sequence.
Complete M-A-C for the right-outlane Special.
Build Hole Bonus with the captive ball and collect it at the right hole.

machineSetup: Confirm whether the blue- or yellow-memory ROM is installed, then verify the drop-bank award order, Bonus X ceiling, Extra Ball conversion, Special conversion, and balls per game.
Test every M-A-C lane, all four drop targets, the captive ball, center and upper-left targets, both Special outlanes, the upper Extra Ball lane, and the right Hole Bonus collect.
